predecessors.name: Magyars
predecessors.text: the Magyar tribal union's lands in the Carpathian Basin; Cliopatria's Magyars row (840-910) overlaps this state in 900-910

predecessors.name: Principality of Lower Pannonia
predecessors.text: Pannonia, the region west of the Danube, occupied in 900

predecessors.name: Great Moravia
predecessors.text: the eastern area of Great Moravia (Slovakia) occupied from 902

successors.name: Kingdom of Hungary
successors.text: the Christian Kingdom of Hungary crowned at Esztergom

capitals.name: Árpádváros (Pécs), winter quarters of the prince

ledger.x: 900: the Magyar tribes hold the Carpathian Basin as a principality under Árpád.
900: the Hungarians occupy Pannonia west of the Danube.
902: the Hungarians take the eastern parts of Great Moravia.
July 907: after Pressburg (4-6 July) the Hungarian-Bavarian border is fixed on the Enns.
926: Croatia takes Slavonia out of Cliopatria's Hungarian shape.
c. 955: the seat moves to Esztergom and Székesfehérvár. Infobox: 'Esztergom and Székesfehérvár (from the reigns of Taksony and Géza)'; Taksony's reign begins c. 955.
10 August 955: Otto I defeats the Hungarians at the Lechfeld and starts the reconquest of the march.
c. 960: the reconquest ends with a new Eastern March. 'Otto I had a new Eastern March (marcha orientalis) erected and by about 960, he appointed Burchard as margrave.'
c. 960: Lower Austria passes to Otto I's new Eastern March under Burchard (Leopold of Babenberg from 976). Cliopatria's 960 shape drops it. The page dates the margrave 'by about 960'.
960: Cliopatria drops Styria with Lower Austria.
25 December 1000: Stephen I is crowned at Esztergom and the principality becomes the Kingdom of Hungary.

wars.name: Hungarian conquest of the Carpathian Basin
wars.outcome: Hungarian victory: Pannonia occupied in 900, the eastern parts of Great Moravia taken from 902, Bavarians crushed at Pressburg (4-6 July 907), which 'is considered the conclusion of the Hungarian Conquest'.

wars.name: Hungarian invasions of Europe
wars.outcome: Raids from 899 to 955 across Italy, Germany, Burgundy, Provence and Spain; checked at the Lechfeld on 10 August 955 ('finally checked their expansion'); the last campaign, with Sviatoslav at Arcadiopolis in 970, 'concluded the Hungarian invasions of Europe'.

wars.name: Reconquest of the Eastern March after the Lechfeld
wars.outcome: Otto I's victory of 955 'started the reconquest'; by about 960 Burchard is margrave of a new Eastern March; Leopold of Babenberg replaces him in 976.

wars.name: Koppány's revolt
wars.outcome: The Principality page lists 'Koppány's revolt: 997' in its infobox under Stephen; the page opened gives no further detail, so the outcome is not recorded here.

certainty.note: A steppe-edge principality with a march or borderland (gyepű) on every side; no treaty line.
